name: openrig
description: Work with your OpenRig team from your coding agent: hand it work, follow that work, answer its questions and read what it returns.

interface.longDescription: Hand your OpenRig team work from this agent, follow it, answer the team's questions and read what it returns, through OpenRig's MCP server. Tools and guidance only: it adds no panel, and nothing wakes a chat when the team finishes.
